scope: Semantic delta review for the final GALX private-creation release candidate. The September 25 Phase 5 domain review remains the baseline for unchanged sources; this record covers the changed allowance, storage, lifecycle, product-copy, and release-status contracts.

Private human images use the Vercel application-side R2 configuration and require server-only credentials before checkout or image receipt creation. No application/runtime call path requires a dedicated Cloudflare Worker image-bucket binding.

Historical image provenance and hosted/CDN state remain unknown. The new private path is separately scoped; historical uncertainty does not itself invalidate local candidate readiness or authorize production mutation.
Release certification now distinguishes local release-candidate readiness from production deployment; hosted/deployment uncertainty remains visible and is not converted into a local code failure.
